modern: You have existed as a part. You will disappear into that which produced you; or rather, you will be taken back into its seed-giving principle by transformation.
original: Thou hast existed as a part. Thou shalt disappear in that which produced thee; but rather thou shalt be received back into its seminal principle by transmutation.
